mapper.sql: SELECT r.id, r.pc_asset_id, a.asset_number, a.device_name, r.rental_vendor_id, v.company_name AS vendor_name, r.contract_number, r.rental_start_date, r.rental_end_date, r.monthly_fee, r.contract_file_path, r.return_date, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM pc_acquisition_rental r JOIN pc_assets a ON r.pc_asset_id = a.id JOIN rental_vendors v ON r.rental_vendor_id = v.id

where.if: AND ( a.asset_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%') OR a.device_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%') OR v.company_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%') OR r.contract_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%') )
AND r.return_date IS NULL AND r.rental_end_date BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)
AND r.return_date IS NULL AND r.rental_end_date < CURDATE()

mapper.select: ORDER BY r.rental_end_date ASC LIMIT #{req.size} OFFSET #{req.offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pc_acquisition_rental r JOIN pc_assets a ON r.pc_asset_id = a.id JOIN rental_vendors v ON r.rental_vendor_id = v.id
mapper.update: UPDATE pc_acquisition_rental SET rental_vendor_id = #{rentalVendorId}, contract_number = #{contractNumber}, rental_start_date = #{rentalStartDate}, rental_end_date = #{rentalEndDate}, monthly_fee = #{monthlyFee}, contract_file_path = #{contractFilePath}, return_date = #{returnDate}, returned_by = #{returnedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pc_acquisition_rental WHERE return_date IS NULL AND rental_end_date BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pc_acquisition_rental WHERE return_date IS NULL AND rental_end_date < CURDATE()
SELECT * FROM rental_vendors ORDER BY company_name ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rental_vendors (company_name, contact_name, phone, email, address, note) VALUES (#{companyName}, #{contactName}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{address}, #{note})
mapper.update: UPDATE rental_vendors SET company_name = #{companyName}, contact_name = #{contactName}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, address = #{address}, note = #{note}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
